name: Welver (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, the hoist side divided twenty times into yellow and red bars, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Welver (a lion on red beside an eagle and crossed swords on yellow).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 7 July 2011 the municipality was granted the right to bear a flag, described as yellow and red striped 1:1 with the hoist side divided twenty times into yellow and red.

features.role: hoist side barry of twenty yellow and red
